name: fable_expression_actors_v3

abi.input: face_render_key_t schema v2 (40 bytes) + 16 kHz sample clock
abi.output: 160x120 RGB565, caller-owned buffer, every pixel written

profiles.name: Mochi Cat (plush mascot)
profiles.structure: eared plush mascot, bead eyes, muzzle lip mouth
profiles.signature: articulated ears + whisker droop + embarrassed head-turn

profiles.name: Karakuri Brass (plate puppet)
profiles.structure: segmented brass plates, shutter irises, integrated hinged jaw cavity
profiles.signature: visor drop, shutter blinks + lower-leaf squints, cheek lamps, jaw hinge plate

profiles.name: Emote Sticker (badge face)
profiles.structure: outlined badge, big teeth/tongue mouth, arc joy-eyes
profiles.signature: emoji glyph accessories scaled by the acting curve

profiles.name: Will-o-Wisp (night spirit)
profiles.structure: row-profiled emissive silhouette morphing around FIXED face anchors
profiles.signature: silhouette emotion + asymmetric brow/lid speech peaks; >=2.5px features at 40x30

profiles.name: Mono Scope (cyclops robot)
profiles.structure: eye-only cyclops: lens + shutter lids + brow bar, no mouth panel
profiles.signature: eye-light carries speech (jaw/width/round/press/teeth/tongue mapped onto it); smile-cut parented to mouth corners; wide pupil saccades

ir_coverage.proof: test_all_forty_bytes_live: every IR byte changes pixels on every profile

verification.wasm: hash tables identical to native (emcc -O2, node)
verification.xtensa: esp32s3 gcc 14.2.0 clean, no float helper symbols

license_note: all code original to this contribution; behavior constants from published research and permissive first-party docs; no GPL or leaked-source code

v4_notes.mono_scope: eye-only; mouth panel removed; all mouth IR bytes remapped onto the eye-light and proven live
v4_notes.wisp: fixed face anchors, face-band glow minimum, asymmetric speech acting
v4_notes.karakuri: integrated jaw cavity + hinge plate, lower-leaf squints, wider gaze travel
v4_notes.mochi: no facial noise, thick closed lids, embarrassed head-turn, no breath chin bob
v4_notes.rasterizer: fixed Q8-fraction bug in stroke AA and glow falloff (thin strokes were invisible)
v4_notes.safety: mouth lower-bezier hard caps folded into probe extents
